result.title: Temporal Rank in Recurrent Neural Networks
result.summary: Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) are a natural framework for temporal modelling, yet are often dismissed due to their sequential, non-parallelisable computation and difficulty in capturing long-range dependencies, typically attributed to vanishing and exploding gradients. We identify a distinct and under-explored limitation: an information bottleneck induced by rank-constrained hidden state dynamics, which limits the number of independent input directions that can be preserved over time, as reflected in the rank of the input-to-state mapping. We show that this constraint restricts temporal capacity independently of gradient stability. To address this, we introduce structured high-dimensional state dynamics that preserve temporal separability and prevent saturation of the input-to-state Jacobian over time. On controlled sequence tasks, the resulting model exhibits rapid learning despite remaining strictly within a standard RNN formulation. Our results demonstrate that RNN performance is governed by the evolution and preservation of temporal rank, and suggest that mitigating gradient pathologies alone is insufficient without explicitly maintaining temporal capacity.

AI.brief_summary: 论文指出循环网络存在一个独立于梯度问题的瓶颈：隐藏状态动力学的低秩结构限制了输入到状态映射可长期保留的独立输入方向，即时间秩；并提出结构化高维状态动力学，使输入-状态雅可比随时间不饱和，从而在标准 RNN 框架内保持时间可分性并加快学习。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「状态秩饱和限制可保留信息方向」的诊断或可供核查循环式 latent 推理中多步状态更新的容量上限与信息坍缩，高维结构化状态动力学也可能为维持 latent 轨迹可分性提供线索，但原文仅涉及纯序列任务。
